run_dump_hubert_feature_s2t: run the script to dump HuBERT features from audio files listed in a TSV using a specified model checkpoint and layer
run_HubertFeatureReaderS2T_read_audio: run the HubertFeatureReaderS2T class to read an audio file and return a 1D waveform tensor
run_get_path_iterator: run the get_path_iterator function to yield audio file paths from a TSV file for a given shard and rank
review_HubertFeatureReaderS2T: review the HubertFeatureReaderS2T class that extends HubertFeatureReader to read audio via the speech-to-text get_features_or_waveform utility
refactor_main: refactor the main function to support additional arguments or different feature dumping strategies for HuBERT features
